invariants: Every new human room message reaches every agent member; direct messages retain their audience.
Idle agents take native Codex turns by default. Busy agents assess relevance inside the existing native loop; ordinary room input does not kill active work.
Hollywood owns authenticated messages, membership, ordering, fanout and communication receipts, not executor reservations or turn supervision.
LAX owns native input, durable per-agent reception, processes, turns, cancellation, recovery and tool execution.
No mandatory leader; every agent has persistent identity/context and knows relevant participants and responsibilities.
No blanket model polling, historical task replay, automatic agent creation, or acknowledgement cascades.
Accepted communication, native input consumed, outward reply and completed work remain distinct.
Unknown external effects retain exact original operation identities and require reconciliation.

milestones.proof: Same canonical human event to two agent members; private isolation; cursor paging/reconnect; membership revocation; zero execution deliveries/executors/models.

milestones.scope: Reuse Codex start-or-steer input and legacy idle/busy room admission behavior while preserving authenticated human/peer provenance and durable input identity. Queue peer observations without model wake loops.
milestones.proof: Same human message to two independent native threads; relevant followup remains in same active turn; passive peer context starts zero model turns and is recalled by model; actual peer question/reply and deliberate public result with zero Hollywood execution deliveries/executors.

milestones.scope: Run the already-proven conversation loop as a maintained long-lived native agent runtime, using existing identities/threads and full normal tools. Deliver new human input during real work without per-message process launches. Native crash durability is a separate hardening track, not the next product milestone.
milestones.nextProof: A human gives actual bounded development work in a room, both native agents participate with normal tools, a later human turn reaches the same contexts, and one agent asks a question answered in that room.
milestones.proof: Existing lax-connect entrypoint selects explicit conversational mode; actual prior native thread cold-resumed and authenticated stream connected with zero model turns or execution claims. Native tool collaboration separately passed. No live migration yet.
milestones.remaining: Integrate question/approval and administrative callbacks without delivery-claim dependency; qualify continued human work through maintained entry, cross-host/client journeys.

milestones.scope: Integrate full native tools, roster/roles, explicit publication, cooperation, question/answer and ordinary idle/busy behavior into the maintained runtime; preserve private and agent authorship.
Extend proven local loop across existing NATS/member hosts without SSH-based agent work or central execution dependency.
Android/web room input, live actions/messages, status, questions, scoped controls, voice and attention-based notifications.

Close native pre-persistence acknowledgement gap and prove restart/lost-ACK/compaction handling before unattended migration. Retain original uncertain handoffs without resend meanwhile. This work does not gate isolated functional room development.
milestones.proof: Publication lost-ACK real HTTP proof passed; connector journal survives reopen; native commitment barrier remains open.

milestones.scope: Preserve original message IDs, active contexts, queues, pairings, drafts, receipts and deliberate stops; one reversible coordinated release.

acceptance: Human plus multiple actual native agents, one public message received by all idle members.
Human update during useful work incorporated at native input boundaries without a second competing turn.
Peer contribution and handoff, no endless response loop or duplicate edits.
Question and human answer resume same context.
Transport outage, lost ACK and runtime restart preserve original input and avoid duplicate business actions.
Cross-host room agents deliver a compatible NextComp update through the existing immutable artifact distribution path.
nonClaims: Communication feed proof is not native model behavior proof.
Prior executor timeout patch is not the target architecture.
executionOrder: Next: maintained local room runtime with full native tools and ongoing real work, rather than another crash-recovery study.
Prove ordinary continued human conversation, agent cooperation, and an actionable question/answer in the same room.
Extend that working room across CPU and GPU through existing local Hollywood/NATS paths; each agent executes locally.
Integrate Android and web into that same canonical conversation/activity/state path, retaining voice and questions.
Complete durability/reconnect/cancellation hardening against the working runtime before unattended migration.
Move this development into the qualified room and demonstrate a compatible NextComp update produced across hosts and delivered through existing update distribution.
priorityCorrection: 2026-10-30: crash recovery was incorrectly treated as the immediate critical path. Build the usable maintained room next; durability remains a migration requirement, not a reason to defer functional milestones.

realAcceptanceCase.request: Allocate agents in this room to parallelize room UX, browser parity and readiness work.
realAcceptanceCase.alreadyObserved: Global announced Android UX implementer and independent client QA allocation; source retains web and runtime/release ownership. Allocation and artifacts must be reconciled before further dispatch.
successCriteria: Existing assignments, contexts and receipts are reconciled; no duplicate workers or human request replay.
Agents perform useful local implementation with full native tools, communicate directly with attributed room messages, and receive human follow-ups in ongoing contexts.
Android keyboard stays focused after send; routine executor lifecycle is activity rather than alarming room chat.
Browser exposes usable room conversation, activity, questions and source-bound controls alongside existing sessions.
CPU/GPU agents cooperate locally through Hollywood/NATS, without SSH-based agent work.
Actual integrated client journeys pass; compatible update is published through existing delivery paths with exact artifacts and honest physical-device limits.
Useful results and genuine blockers are reported in the original room; no model polling or acknowledgement cascades.
realAcceptanceCase.completionRule: A successful synthetic conversation or allocation announcement alone does not fulfill this request or the whole vision.
